name: din-5008-css
description: css for layouting a A4 paper according to DIN-5008

scripts.prepare: awk 'BEGIN{while((getline line < "din-5008.css") > 0) css = css line "\n"} /CSS/{gsub(/CSS/, css); print; next} {print}' index.js > index.js.tmp && mv index.js.tmp index.js

author: Hannes Diercks <din-5008-css@xiphe.net>
